verdict.rationale: Runpod documents Instant Clusters as fully managed multi-node compute with high-performance networking, meant for training models too large for one GPU or speeding up training across nodes. Its pricing page lists Clusters alongside self-serve Pods and Serverless, so provisioning appears self-serve; the enterprise-sales route is described only for reserved capacity and contract pricing. Missing for 10: interconnect specifics (e.g. InfiniBand/bandwidth figures), explicit documentation of self-serve cluster provisioning steps or cluster pricing, and independent hands-on corroboration.
